name: EffectsSpace
tagline: A C# motion-design and compositing workbench for desktop and browser
summary: EffectsSpace is an independent motion-design and compositing application built with Uno Platform, .NET and SkiaSharp, operating on a real composition model of layers, nested compositions, keyframes, masks, mattes, effects, video frames and audio samples. The browser app is the same C# Uno workbench compiled to WebAssembly, drawing preview into Uno's existing Skia canvas. It imports Motion JPEG AVI and PCM WAVE media and exports PNG sequences, AVI with sound and high-precision WAVE mixes.
inspiredBy: Adobe After Effects-style motion design tools

highlights.title: Layered compositions
highlights.text: Shapes, Bezier paths, text, images, Motion JPEG video, PCM audio, nulls, guides, adjustment layers and nested pre-comps.

highlights.title: Keyframe animation
highlights.text: Stopwatches, auto-key, linear/hold/Bezier interpolation, Easy Ease and value or signed-velocity graphs.

highlights.title: Multi-key editing
highlights.text: Select, marquee, retime, copy, cut and paste keys across transform, effect and audio channels as single undoable transactions.

highlights.title: Masks and mattes
highlights.text: Independently feathered Add/Subtract/Intersect masks with direct node editing, plus alpha and luma track mattes.

highlights.title: Effects and blend modes
highlights.text: Blur, Glow, Drop Shadow, Exposure, Fractal Noise, Vignette and more, with seventeen blend modes and masked adjustment layers.

highlights.title: Bounded expressions
highlights.text: Side-effect-free scalar expressions with time, clamp, linear, ease, wiggle and loopOut; not JavaScript and no host access.

highlights.title: Real media and audio
highlights.text: Import Motion JPEG AVI and PCM WAVE, remap source time, animate gain/balance and preview on the Web Audio clock.

highlights.title: Precision delivery
highlights.text: Export transparent PNG sequences, Motion JPEG AVI with stereo sound, or PCM16/PCM24/Float32 WAVE with optional TPDF dither.

items: Solids, rounded rectangles, ellipses, stars, Bezier paths and inline-edited text
Images, Motion JPEG video, PCM audio, nulls and guides
Parent chains, nested compositions and pre-compose
Seventeen blend modes and multi-sample composition motion blur
Fit, zoom and pan
Move, eight scale handles, rotation and anchor compensation
Pen tool with symmetric Bezier handles and path node editing
Direct mask node and tangent editing with cancellation
Frame-snapped time, stopwatches and auto-key
Linear, Hold and Bezier interpolation with Easy Ease
Value and signed-velocity graph editors
Multi-key selection, retiming, nudging and session-local clipboard
Bounded scalar expressions: wiggle, loopOut, linear, ease, clamp
Masked adjustment layers that affect only layers below
Alpha, alpha inverted, luma and luma inverted track mattes
Add/Subtract/Intersect/None masks with opacity, feather, expansion and inversion
Time remap, freeze frame and continuous remap-curve reversal
Blur, Glow and Drop Shadow
Exposure, Brightness/Contrast, Hue/Saturation and Tint
Invert and Posterize
Fractal Noise fill generator and Vignette overlay
Classic Motion JPEG AVI with optional PCM audio
Mono/stereo integer and float WAVE, 8–192 kHz
Gain and balance automation with source waveform display
Band-limited windowed-sinc resampling with an exact same-rate path
Versioned, self-contained .effects projects with embedded media
IndexedDB (browser) and local app-data (desktop) recovery
Transparent PNG frames and ZIP PNG sequences with a rational manifest
Motion JPEG AVI with PCM16/48 kHz sound and PCM16/PCM24/Float32 WAVE mixes

codeSamples.title: Run on desktop and publish for the browser
codeSamples.code:
# Fetch checksum-verified open typography and retain its license
python3 scripts/fetch-assets.py

# Native desktop: Windows, macOS or Linux
dotnet run --project src/EffectsSpace.App -f net10.0-desktop \
  -p:EffectsSpaceDesktopOnly=true

# Real Uno WebAssembly application
dotnet workload install wasm-tools
dotnet publish src/EffectsSpace.App -f net10.0-browserwasm -c Release \
  -o artifacts/publish -p:WasmShellWebAppBasePath=/EffectsSpace/
python3 scripts/collect-site.py artifacts/publish artifacts/site
python3 scripts/serve-site.py --directory artifacts/site --port 4173

codeSamples.title: Run the engine and media test suites
codeSamples.code:
# Engine and media regression executables
dotnet run --project tests/EffectsSpace.Tests -c Release
dotnet run --project tests/EffectsSpace.Animation.Tests -c Release
dotnet run --project tests/EffectsSpace.Skia.Tests -c Release
dotnet run --project tests/EffectsSpace.Compositing.Tests -c Release
dotnet run --project tests/EffectsSpace.Media.Tests -c Release
dotnet run --project tests/EffectsSpace.Media.Skia.Tests -c Release
dotnet run --project tests/EffectsSpace.Audio.Tests -c Release

# Independent media validation: requires test-only FFmpeg/ffprobe
python3 scripts/verify-media.py
python3 scripts/verify-audio.py

# Real keyboard, pointer, file-picker and download interactions
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npx playwright install chromium
npm run test:browser

playground.intro: The browser studio opens the editable ORBITAL motion study at its hero frame, running the same C# workbench compiled to WebAssembly.

tour.title: Explore ORBITAL
tour.text: Click compositions in the Project panel and double-click a composition layer to enter the nested orbital system.

tour.title: Draw and transform
tour.text: Drag with the Rectangle, Ellipse or Star tool, then press V to move, scale with the eight handles, or W to rotate.

tour.title: Animate a property
tour.text: Enable a stopwatch, move the playhead, change the value, then press F9 for Easy Ease and Shift F3 to open the graph.

tour.title: Add an effect and mask
tour.text: Pick an entry in Effects & Presets, then Add Mask and open Composite (Shift F5) to feather or edit its path.

tour.title: Try real media
tour.text: Press Ctrl Alt L to load the CLOCKWORK video/audio study and open Media with Shift F7 to see its waveform.

tour.title: Export
tour.text: Snapshot a transparent PNG, render a PNG sequence, or export AVI with Ctrl Alt M and a WAVE mix with Ctrl Alt W.

architecture.name: Model and documents
architecture.text: Uno- and Skia-free compositions, layers and rational time, plus validated versioned documents and storage contracts.

architecture.name: Animation and editing
architecture.text: Curves, easing and bounded expressions with atomic transactions, selection-aware history and keyframe clipboard.

architecture.name: Rendering and media
architecture.text: Renderer-neutral frame plans and portable AVI/WAVE media, composited through SkiaSharp.

architecture.name: Studio controls
architecture.text: Original Uno controls plus Skia-painted viewer and timeline surfaces drawn into SKCanvasElement.

architecture.name: Workbench
architecture.text: Panels, transport, render queue and document workflows hosted by a thin desktop/WebAssembly app.

boundaries: Development alpha of 2D editing, not complete Adobe After Effects parity
No MP4/H.264/WebM, 3D, tracking, Adobe formats/plugins or dedicated WebGPU renderer
Native timeline preview is silent; browser audible preview is limited to 60 seconds
8-bit sRGB workflow: no HDR, linear-light or color management; AVI export has no alpha
Embedded media limited to 32 MiB per asset and 64 MiB total; exports capped at 3600 frames
